g.text: A single quarter now adds more than the whole installed base of two years ago

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: What it shows: how much compute was added in each quarter, rather than how much stood installed. The cumulative view can

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: only imply this through its slope; here it is the quantity itself, over the 16 complete quarters.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Source: Epoch AI, AI Chip Owners (CC-BY) — quarters_by_chip_type.csv + cumulative_by_designer.csv — epoch.ai/data/ai-chip-owners

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Methodology: Methodology reference pending final methodology document; derivation follows Epoch AI's published AI chip owners documentation

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: Additions have risen every year and reached 4.5M H100e in 2025Q4 — more than the entire installed base as recently as 2023Q4. Read

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: from Epoch's own quarterly file rather than by differencing the cumulative one; the two agree to within a fraction of a percent but

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: are separately estimated. Almost none of this is disclosed by the owners: Epoch estimates it from filings, supply-chain reporting and

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: satellite work, and publishes a 5th-95th percentile beside every median. OWNERS-D02 charts that interval, which is wide and very

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280
